DML.SELECT: SELECT user_id as "id", role_id as "roleId", name_ as "name", password_ as "password", password_expired_at as "passwordExpiredAt", session_expire_time_s as "sessionExpireTimeS", locked_until as "lockedUntil", preset as "preset", allow_multiple_sessions as "allowMultipleSessions", full_name as "fullName", email as "email", locale_code as "localeCode", ldap as "ldap", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM conf.users WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.users (user_id, role_id, name_, password_, password_expired_at, session_expire_time_s, locked_until, preset, allow_multiple_sessions, full_name, email, locale_code, ldap, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.users'$'user_id'}, :roleId, :name, :password, :passwordExpiredAt, :sessionExpireTimeS, :lockedUntil, :preset, :allowMultipleSessions, :fullName, :email, :localeCode, :ldap, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.users SET role_id = :roleId, name_ = :name, password_ = :password, password_expired_at = :passwordExpiredAt, session_expire_time_s = :sessionExpireTimeS, locked_until = :lockedUntil, preset = :preset, allow_multiple_sessions = :allowMultipleSessions, full_name = :fullName, email = :email, locale_code = :localeCode, ldap = :ldap, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = :id
